thread_title: S. montana 'best clone' Transylvania Co, NC ( M.R.)
breadcrumb: S. montana 'best clone' Transylvania Co, NC ( M.R.)

posts.body_html:
This is the best clone from a friend of mine (M.R.), and consequently, when compared to all my other montanas from the same county, this plant is also my best clone too! The colors are intense, and the shape is outstanding on this clone. It does look slightly different from my other transylvania Co montanas, which makes me wonder if it's from a different population originally.
